resolved.A01: Removed credential entry from the page; the existing Options control opens extension settings.
resolved.A02: Escaped external DOM, attribute, card and TSV fields; malformed AI entries are rejected or skipped. Card highlighting splits source text before encoding so entity names cannot be highlighted accidentally.
resolved.A03: Added analysis ownership and a same-context duplicate gate; stale successes and errors cannot change a new drawer context or enrich its card.
resolved.A04: Centralized timeline installation, added acquisition generations and source ranks, and ordered manual requests. Captions settle before automatic lyrics; the latest manual selection wins.
resolved.A05: Published overlay-hidden state to the MAIN-world bridge; hidden playback leaves native CC and track choices alone.
resolved.A06: Unified Quick and enriched Anki saves, configured routing/deck, kana and romaji, bare/wrapped AI data, truthful outcome labels, and one safe TSV exporter.
resolved.A07: Serialized card save and clear in the real worker, validated payloads, checked acknowledgements/errors, and retried durable saves after evicting expendable caches.
resolved.A08: Disposed old watch state and DOM synchronously; leaving watch detaches video listeners and observers, clears parser state, and hides stale UI.
resolved.A09: Replaced truncated caption-array regex extraction with a bounded balanced JSON scanner; filtered caption URLs belonging to another video.
resolved.A10: Identification and analysis use the selected provider only; saved keys no longer enable cross-provider fallback.
resolved.A11: Removed required wildcard hosts, three unused permissions and two unused fetch proxies. Save and Test request missing configured endpoint origins; denial prevents settings writes.
resolved.A12: Removed the duplicate reading engine from the data file and repointed legacy reading tests at the shipped closure. The unrelated legacy copied helper tests remain outside this reading-engine change.
resolved.X01: Bounded WanaKana conversion at semantic boundaries, including long marks, sokuon, syllabic n and surrogate pairs; skipped identity ASCII chunks without changing their output.
resolved.X02: Replaced quadratic tag stripping with a linear scanner that preserves original regex semantics.
resolved.X03/R01: Bounded translations to 500 LRU entries and lyrics to 50 entries / 2,000,000 indexed payload bytes. Reconciled legacy unindexed keys and preserved user cards/settings.
resolved.X04: Guarded repeated class/style/hidden writes and reused one lazy Japanese Segmenter.
resolved.R03: Honored the configured caption backend and bounded acquisition fetches with AbortSignals.
resolved.R04: Serialized title and channel prompt fields with JSON.stringify.

limitations: Real YouTube lifecycle/CSP, external model services, optional permission dialog grant, real Sudachi and real Anki/CORS were not exercised.
The existing Chromium suite skips real Sudachi without PARSER_SERVER_DIR.
Same-text render memoization remains a SOFT miss, explicitly deferred in the proposal.
Provider/Anki transport migration, cross-provider opt-in, network disclosure policy, legacy TSV deck header, duplicate cleanup, timer/observer redesign and long-duration leak claims remain deferred.
